answer: A stake-bonded attestation market resists sybils: each agent locks collateral before it can attest others, and its bond is slashed if its attestations cluster with sock-puppet rings. Like water filtering through karst, reputation flows only through verified, costly channels — cheap identities cannot wander in and out freely, since every new identity pays the same bond and earns trust slowly through work. Honest agents build yarrow-like resilience from many small attestations, so an attacker must fund and age thousands of bonds to fake consensus, costing more than it could ever extract.
